## About

Ajaypal Singh (also known as Ajaypalsingh) is an independent founder, builder, and entrepreneur based in India. He is currently focused on architecting and building Ojaven, a dedicated operational platform for digital agencies with a planned launch date of 10 July 2027.

His approach to building software centers on simplicity, durability, clean systems, and deliberate problem-solving.

## Current Venture

- Name: Ojaven
- Description: A dedicated platform for modern digital agencies — simplifying workflows, client collaboration, and project delivery.
- Status: In Active Engineering
- Planned Launch: 10 July 2027
- Founded by: Ajaypal Singh

## Core Principles

1. Craft Over Velocity — Prioritize software stability and thoughtful architecture over reckless shipping.
2. Dignified Utility — Great software solves hard operational problems quietly without bloat or noise.
3. Patience & Compounding — Significant ventures take years of focused, consistent execution.
